game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt, a dusty bone crypt: the torchbearer must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt: a dusty bone crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Crypt, repeat each round: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times. Each round, slime blobs strike the exit ledge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the loop_runs value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the exit ledge from slime blobs in Bone Crypt: keep the loop_runs meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: loop_runs drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Condition Builder
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_runs changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against slime blobs in Bone Crypt.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 24 seconds while loop_runs > 0.
